question: Which models does Quill support?
answer: Quill works with the leading models from Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, and open-source providers. Pick a model per step, and swap it later without rebuilding your agent.

question: Is my data used for training?
answer: Never. Your data stays yours — it's isolated per workspace, encrypted at rest, and never used to train shared models. Enterprise plans add a zero-retention option.

question: Can I self-host or use my own keys?
answer: Yes. Bring your own model API keys on any plan. Self-hosted and dedicated deployments are available on Enterprise.

question: How does billing work for runs?
answer: Each plan includes a monthly run allowance. A run is one full execution of an agent, however many steps it takes. Go over and you're billed per additional run — never cut off mid-job.

question: Do you offer a startup discount?
answer: Yes. Early-stage startups can get 50% off Pro for their first year. Reach out and we'll get you set up.
